verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm, not a software product or service with user-facing data settings, so user-controlled data retention and deletion is the wrong axis for this kind of offering. Its GDPR advisory practice and its internal use of AI tools are legal and operational services, not a product capability that lets users control their own data. The evidence pack shows no Gide-operated platform with retention or deletion controls that would make the axis applicable.
